cs.t: How do you find the Poker2? I have one and tried it for 6 months. But I always felt cramped, hard to explain. Might be because it is brown switches, where I use blues for all my other keyboards.
cs.th: Ask HN: Best keyboard layout for programming?

cs.t: You should use whichever lets you work easiest. I have a few keybindings on my keyboard because it makes my life easier but others have different keybindings. I use a Poker2 or Poker3 and I make the Win key Fn and I switch Capslock and F12 and my terminal is pulled up with F12 (meaning I can hit Capslock to get my terminal)
